source.notes: The organizer identifies V2 as Grandstand Upper Tier and V1 as Lower Tier. The live page now concerns 2027; used here only for the existing permanent structural relationship, not 2026 ticket availability. Upper front floor is estimated 2m above the lower back floor (plausible landing/structure gap 1–3m), not a surveyed height. Existing lower/upper rises remain separate estimates. This datum is defined independently of raycast visibility; do not optimize height to pass a sightline test.
